query: How many organisations are currently listed as signatories on the EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice signatory page (digital-strategy.ec.europa.eu/en/policies/ai-code-practice) as of July 2026? List the count and names if possible.
answer:
I've completed the research. Here's the answer to your question:

**As of the most recent official EU Commission update (dated 23 April 2026, the closest confirmed vintage to July 2026), the EU General-Purpose AI Code of Practice signatory page lists 23 full signatory organisations, plus 1 partial signatory (xAI, Safety & Security chapter only).**

The 23 full signatories are:
Accexible, AI Studio Delta, Aleph Alpha, Almawave, Amazon, Anthropic, Black Forest Labs, Bria AI, Cohere, Domyn, Dweve, Fastweb, Google, IBM, Lawise, LINAGORA, Microsoft, Mistral AI, Open Hippo, OpenAI, Pleias, ServiceNow, and WRITER.

**Key caveat:** The Commission continuously updates this list as new signatures are confirmed, so the count fluctuates. It started at ~26 companies at the August 2025 launch. The figure of 23 reflects the latest confirmed snapshot of the official page (23 April 2026); a precise July 2026 count could differ slightly if additional signatures were added or reconciled in the interim. Notably, Meta declined to sign and is not on the list.
